name: demo_transfer
description: Log in with the given username and password, open the Transfer Funds page, transfer the given amount from the given source account to the given destination account, and confirm the transfer completed

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open the Transfer Funds page, transfer the given amount from the given source account to the given destination account, and confirm the transfer completed

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay reusable fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Transfer Funds page
steps.action: Click the 'Transfer Funds' link in the authenticated navigation menu

steps.intent: Fill in the transfer form with the given amount, source account, and destination account
steps.action: Enter the amount into the amount field, select the source account from the 'From Account' dropdown, and select the destination account from the 'To Account' dropdown
Click the 'Transfer' button to execute the fund transfer
Verify that the transfer confirmation heading and success message are displayed on the page
